subject: Architecture contract section 02.9 published
body:
Architecture contract published in live [§02.9] + [§01.7] + [§02.4.10].

REQUIRED: 32-bit semantic identity and 32-bit T2 addresses. High-bit zero checks on Arty. Generation-check before use. EdgeRecord has no utility/Q.

ARCHITECTURE CANDIDATE WIDTHS (not physics): directory 128, node/edge/context/provenance 256, value 128, posting header 128, posting entry 64.

IMPLEMENTATION-DEFINED: MIG app_data width remains UNKNOWN until you read generated MIG. Packing, pipeline, BRAM banking, page_size number, CRC polynomial.

MAY: fold/pipeline/time-multiplex; pack two PostingEntry per 128-bit group.

MUST NOT: 24-bit ID type, 28-bit pointer type, resize records to match MIG, infer truth from T1, claim latency/single-cycle/DDR efficiency, map protocol faults to UNKNOWN.

Claim ceiling: architecture contract updated. Not RTL_PASS / TIMING_PASS / MIG_PASS / BOARD_PASS.

Still open: add 05_CAPABILITY_AND_ACTION_BINDING.md to schema_lock.json.
